Automated Model Briefing

⚠ AI-generated text — may be wrong, incomplete, or overconfident. This is automated commentary on experimental model output, not flight advice and not a weather forecast. It has not been reviewed by a meteorologist.

Overall Assessment A solid thermal day with strong lift (peak w* 643 fpm domain-wide) and no overdevelopment or precipitation. However, wind directions are off for ridge soaring at most sites except Rainbow Ridge and Slide Mountain. The sharp lapse rate (10.1 °C/km 0–1.5 km AGL) and multiple shear layers demand advanced pilot skills; the best window is late morning to mid-afternoon at sites with aligned winds.

Site Breakdown

  • Kingsbury Grade: Marginal — wind direction persistently N–NE, outside preferred SE sector for ridge lift, but light winds allow thermal flying. Preferred window 11am–4pm, peak w* 363 fpm, thermal ceiling 2187 ft AGL. Sharp thermals (lapse rate 8.4 °C/km) — advanced pilots only.
  • Hallelujah: Marginal — strong E–SE wind opposes preferred W–SW launch, ruling out ridge soaring; strong thermals (peak w* 450 fpm, ceiling 4648 ft AGL) may still give extended flights. Best thermal window 1:30–5pm. Sharp thermals (8.9 °C/km).
  • Slide Mountain: Favorable — on-preferred SE winds 8am–2pm align with launch, light (≤9 mph), and decent thermal activity (peak w* 342 fpm, ceiling 1700 ft AGL). Lapse rate 6.6 °C/km, no sharp thermal caution. Window 8am–4pm.
  • McClellan: Marginal — winds start SE then shift NW, crossing the SW–S launch; strong thermals (peak w* 473 fpm, ceiling 4522 ft AGL) but sharp (9.0 °C/km) and shearing. Best window 10:30am–4pm. Peak layer speed shear 8 mph and directional change 30° aloft.
  • West McClellan: Marginal — all winds from E to NE, completely off preferred W–NW; no ridge lift. Strong thermals (peak w* 447 fpm, ceiling 4363 ft AGL) but sharp (8.8 °C/km) and with hazardous shear (8 mph speed, 35° dir). Window 11:30am–6pm for thermal/sled flights.
  • Peavine Mountain: Marginal — winds ESE–NE, well outside S–SW preferred launch; moderate thermals (peak w* 378 fpm, ceiling 1974 ft AGL) and calm winds. Sharp thermals not flagged (lapse 7.4), but hazardous directional shear 43° and speed shear 5 mph. Window 10am–5pm.
  • Rainbow Ridge: Favorable — wind stays in the preferred ENE window all day (up to 11 mph), providing ridge lift. Strong thermals (peak w* 481 fpm, ceiling 4625 ft AGL) but sharp (9.1 °C/km) and with shear (5 mph speed, 41° dir). Best window 10:30am–5pm. Advanced pilots only.
  • Duck Hill: Marginal — wind variable and off in the morning, becomes NW and aligns with preferred sector afternoon. Strong thermals (peak w* 455 fpm, ceiling 4050 ft AGL) but sharp (8.9 °C/km) and shearing (7 mph speed, 31° dir). Best window 1–6pm.
  • Daydreams: Unfavorable — strong E crosswind (gusts 19 mph) opposes SW launch all day, with weak thermal activity (peak w* 230 fpm, ceiling 1624 ft AGL). Not recommended.

Hazards

  • Sharp thermals (lapse rate >8 °C/km) at Kingsbury, Hallelujah, McClellan, West McClellan, Rainbow Ridge, Duck Hill, and Daydreams — suitable for advanced/expert pilots only.
  • Low-level wind shear: hazardous speed shear (≥5 mph/layer) at Hallelujah, McClellan, West McClellan, Peavine, Rainbow Ridge, Duck Hill; hazardous directional shear (≥30°) at West McClellan, Peavine, Rainbow Ridge, Duck Hill — expect turbulent layers and possible gust fronts.
  • Crosswind/off-wind launches at all sites except Slide Mountain and Rainbow Ridge — careful launch selection required.

Site Forecast ?Top of Thermals (PBLH) — height of the turbulent mixing layer; thermals typically reach this ceiling.

w* — convective velocity scale; higher = stronger thermals (ft/min).
